scope: Offline structured DSN parsing; no live mail or repository-effect execution.

specification_test_facets.T-25: failed with 4.x.x; attempt outcome, not retry authorization
specification_test_facets.T-26: delayed never enables an application resend
specification_test_facets.T-28: expanded remains intermediate; separate recipients, no expansion graph
specification_test_facets.T-32: parser leaves correlation unresolved; no send-register implementation
specification_test_facets.T-33: retains subcodes and distinguishes address/mailbox/system subjects
specification_test_facets.T-35: recognizes global UTF-8 DSN and routes to review; no lossless EAI decoder
specification_test_facets.T-36: input/allocation/depth/recipient caps, invalid/duplicate fields, inert contents; no hard real-time guarantee
specification_test_facets.T-42: policy error never authorizes resend or recipient disablement
specification_test_facets.T-43: delivery report never asserts communication goal closure

limitations: Unit facets are not full T-25..T-45 acceptance tests.
JSON output contains internal recipient data; not safe for public issue publication.
Raw input SHA-256 is a binding, not durable raw-message retention.
Malformed or internationalized DSNs may require manual review.
